description: How I designed this site so that the numbers shown are recalculated instead of copied.
texte: The problem A proof page written by hand always ends up lying. You write “18 tests”, then add three more, and the page still says 18. Nobody notices, except a buyer who counts. The answer Each project has a manifest, store/projets/<slug>/preuve.yml , which says where its evidence comes from: the test file, the command to run, the SQL query, the files to measure.
